scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true}); if(fs.existsSync('frontend/public/_redirects')) fs.copyFileSync('frontend/public/_redirects', 'dist/_redirects'); if(fs.existsSync('frontend/public/_headers')) fs.copyFileSync('frontend/public/_headers', 'dist/_headers');"
